payload.outcome: Fixed on main by about 20 Oct 2026, checked against 8a81588da on 27 Oct. All four wastes are gone: (1) loadChunksForSignalMatches now does one joined document_chunks + documents!inner query (rag-candidate-sources.ts:1688); (2) attachPageVisualEvidence uses a request-scoped PageVisualCache (rag-hydration.ts:61-91, :361); (3) the indexing version is read once per request through cacheContext.indexingVersionAtRequestStart (rag.ts:1187, :2185), and the remaining fresh reads in rag-cache.ts are the deliberate revocation guard; (4) loadChunksForMemoryCards takes the shared ChunkLoadCache (rag-candidate-sources.ts:1419-1423, :2135), and the typo-correction recursion reuses the request caches via ??= (rag.ts:1156-1157). The remaining search-speed lead is #H69FNZ.
